summary: Verified alembic migration chain fix for invitations_and_outbox (feb2000f209a). From a clean DB, `alembic upgrade head` now completes all 17 migrations through head b1c2d3e4f5a6 with exit 0. The previously-failing `9acf884483b9_comments_and_retry` ALTER TABLE outbox_messages ADD COLUMN attempt_count now runs to completion. All 12 required tables exist with all expected late-migration columns. Migration-smoke flow (head -> downgrade -1 -> upgrade head) passes. Idempotency check: when invitations + outbox_messages already exist (dev DB via create_all), the rewritten migration skips create cleanly. Iter 21 regression suite still 5/5 green against live preview backend. Secret scanner exits 0.
critical_code_review_comments: Migration feb2000f209a is correctly idempotent via inspector check (_has) so dev DBs created via Base.metadata.create_all continue to upgrade cleanly without 'table already exists' errors.

Column set in the rewritten migration deliberately omits attempt_count, next_attempt_at, and cohort — confirmed matches the historical state expected by the subsequent migrations (9acf884483b9 adds the first two, f6b832c5a4e1 adds cohort).

downgrade() in feb2000f209a unconditionally drops tables; would fail on a DB where create_all created them and they have FK refs from later-migration tables not dropped first. Not exercised by the CI migration-smoke (which only does downgrade -1 from head), so non-blocking, but worth flagging.
test_credentials: Did not need; this is purely a migration / DDL test. Live-backend Iter 21 smoke uses its own seeded creds.
seed_data_creation: Created and destroyed two transient SQLite DBs under /tmp/migration_check (check.db, idem.db); cleanup done — no residue in /app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration chain is healthy at head b1c2d3e4f5a6 (17 migrations, 33 tables). To re-verify: `cp -r /app/backend /tmp/mc && cd /tmp/mc && rm -f *.db && DATABASE_URL='sqlite:///./check.db' alembic upgrade head`. For live-backend regression, set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env and run pytest backend/tests/test_iteration21.py.
